beats.say: Brush your teeth, not your antenna!
Okay! Lots and lots of toothpaste!
Just a tiny bit. Like a little pea.
Yes! Now brush round and round.
Did you brush your teeth today?

sources.fact: Brush twice a day for 2 minutes; young children need a pea-sized amount of fluoride toothpaste

post.instagram_caption:
Wibbo is brushing his teeth... sort of! He brushed his antenna and used a mountain of toothpaste.

The right way: a pea-sized bit of toothpaste, round and round, for 2 whole minutes, twice a day.

Silly Wibbo. Smart kids.

Did YOU brush your teeth today?
